items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: Roy LaBord and I went over to Disneyland in Anaheim, California. We spent nine hours in Disneyland and really enjoyed it.

ctx.x: You know, Arthur Godfrey had some pretty good musicians with him at the time.

Oh, pretty good. He had some great musicians with him. I went to Disney World in Orlando, Florida. Well, I went to Disneyland when I was working in Las Vegas. On our day off, Roy LaBord and I went over to Disneyland in Anaheim, California. We spent nine hours in Disneyland and really enjoyed it. And I said to myself, well, I've got to get the wife and kids to Disney World so they can see this, because this is fantastic.
